speaker: Neil L. Andersen
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
summary: Elder Andersen teaches that faith in Jesus Christ and spiritual courage feed each other: faith gives the courage to choose the right, and choosing the right strengthens faith. He shows this through Rosemary Chibota's conversion as a teenager in Zimbabwe, Moroni standing alone, his own quiet summer days with the cows, President Oaks accepting a demanding calling as a young lawyer, and a Spokane family who lost their home to fire. He asks members to seek stillness, pray, keep their covenants and commandments, and promises that answers, spiritual power, and courage will come.

findings.quote: Elder David A. Bednar said: “I believe the Lord’s admonition to ‘be still’ entails much more than simply not talking or not moving. Perhaps His intent is for us to remember and rely upon Him and His power ‘at all times and in all things, and in all places that [we] may be in’ [Mosiah 18:9]. Thus, ‘be still’ may be a way of reminding us to focus upon the Savior unfailingly as the ultimate source of the spiritual stillness of the soul that strengthens us to do and overcome hard things” (“Be Still, and Know That I Am God,” Liahona, May 2024, 28–29).
